protocol.title: Proximity sequencing for the detection of mRNA, extracellular proteins and extracellular protein complexes in single cells
protocol.platform: Proximity ligation assay (PLA) + 10x Chromium 3' single-cell RNA sequencing
cell_lines: Jurkat T cells (positive control for CD147 homodimers)
NCI-H1299 (as general model; user-defined primary cells)
protocol.objective: Simultaneous measurement of extracellular proteins, mRNA, and hundreds of extracellular protein complexes from single cells using DNA-barcoded antibody proximity ligation probes and 10x Chromium 3' V3.1 droplet sequencing

platform_details.single_cell_method: 10x Chromium 3' V3.1 (recommended; best trade-off of data quality, cell throughput, and ease of use)

probe_components: Antibody conjugated to DBCO via NHS ester (dibenzocyclooctyne-PEG4-N-hydroxysuccinimidyl ester)
Azide-functionalized DNA oligonucleotide (Probe A: unique barcode)
Azide-functionalized DNA oligonucleotide (Probe B: unique barcode)
device.ligation_mechanism: T4 ligase + connector oligomer (TTTCACGACACGACACGATTTAGGTC); ligation product formed only when probe A and probe B are within 50-70 nm
device.single_cell_platform: 10x Chromium Controller with Next GEM Chip G
device.gel_bead_kit: Chromium Next GEM single cell 3' GEM, library and gel bead kit v3.1 (cat. 1000268)
device.key_primer_addition: U_fwd primer (2 uM) added to 10x amplification mix at Step 90 to co-amplify PLA products
device.spri_separation_ratio: 0.6x SPRIselect (cDNA on beads; PLA products in supernatant)

reagents.oligos: Custom azide-functionalized DNA oligomers (IDT; sequences from Vistain et al. Nat. Methods 2022)
reagents.carrier_dna: Ultrapure salmon sperm DNA solution (Invitrogen, cat. 15632011)
reagents.probe_binding_buffer: PBS + 0.1% (wt/vol) BSA + 0.1 mg/mL sonicated salmon sperm DNA + 6.7 nM per isotype
reagents.ligation_buffer: 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 10 mM MgCl2, 1 mM rATP, 9.5 nM connector oligomer, 130 U/mL T4 ligase
reagents.t4_ligase: T4 ligase (New England Biolabs, cat. M0202L)
reagents.rnase_inhibitor: RNase inhibitor, murine (New England Biolabs, cat. M0314L)
reagents.dead_cell_removal: Dead cell removal kit (Miltenyi Biotec, cat. 130-090-101)
reagents.pcr_mix: KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix 2x (KAPA Biosystems, cat. KK2601)
reagents.phix_control: NextSeq PhiX control kit (Illumina, cat. FC-110-3002)
reagents.sequencing_kit_mid: NextSeq 500/550 mid-output kit v2.5, 150 cycles (Illumina, cat. 20024904)
reagents.antibody_note: CRITICAL: avoid antibodies formulated with protein (BSA or gelatin); compatible with azide, Tris, glycerol formulations

steps.name: Antibody buffer exchange
steps.purpose: Remove BSA or gelatin from antibody storage buffer; incompatible with DBCO NHS ester conjugation
steps.notes: Same concentrator used for buffer exchange and subsequent purification after DBCO conjugation

steps.name: DBCO stock preparation and antibody conjugation

dbco_stock_preparation.qc_dilution: 1:100 in PBS; read absorbance at 309 nm on Nanodrop

steps.purpose: Conjugate DBCO moiety to antibody lysines via NHS ester chemistry for subsequent click reaction with azide-DNA
steps.notes: On-ice (0 C) incubation modelled in BioScript as heat at 0c for 60m

steps.name: DBCO-antibody purification and QC
steps.purification: Repeat concentrator wash Steps 4-12 to remove unconjugated DBCO

qc.note: Account for DBCO absorbance at 280 nm when calculating antibody concentration

steps.storage: Aliquots at -20 C; avoid freeze-thaw cycles

fail.troubleshooting: Low input mass (<50 ug) or excessive DBCO ratio (>10 DBCO/Ab); increase scale or reduce DBCO

steps.name: Azide-DNA oligo conjugation (click chemistry)

probe_panel_assembly.buffer: PBS + 0.1% BSA + 0.1 mg/mL salmon sperm DNA + 6.7 nM per isotype

steps.storage: 50% (wt/vol) glycerol/PBS at -20 C; stable >= 1 year; 4 C stable for months (antibody-dependent)
steps.notes: Two probes per target protein (A and B); probe A and probe B carry unique barcodes enabling identification of which two proteins ligated

steps.name: Cell pelleting, Fc blocking, and BSA wash
steps.purpose: Fc receptor blocking prevents non-specific antibody binding; BSA wash removes serum proteins before probe staining

steps.name: Prox-seq probe staining
inputs: Prox-seq probe panel in probe binding buffer

steps.name: Post-staining washes
steps.notes: If overprocessing is a concern, reduce washes by at least one

steps.name: PLA ligation
steps.ligation_buffer_composition: 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 10 mM MgCl2, 1 mM rATP, 9.5 nM connector oligomer (TTTCACGACACGACACGATTTAGGTC), 130 U/mL T4 ligase
steps.mechanism: Connector oligomer bridges probe A and probe B oligonucleotides when target proteins are within 50-70 nm; T4 ligase seals the nick to form a covalent PLA ligation product

optional_free_oligo_method.description: Add free oligos A and B sequentially with additional connector to ensure all probes are ligated and measurable even if paired protein is absent
optional_free_oligo_method.note: Improves protein expression level estimates but benefits are minor when targeting many highly expressed proteins; increases overprocessing risk for low-count samples

steps.name: Post-ligation washes and viability check
steps.operation: mix x2 (post-ligation washes) + mix (dead cell removal) + mix (PI staining) + detect (viabilityDetection)
steps.bioscript_liveness_note: viableCells and stainedForSort derive independently from postLigWash2; viableCells is NOT consumed inside the if-gate branches to keep it live at bsbbif_7_j (join block)

fail.troubleshooting: Reduce wash steps (Step 35); increase centrifugation speed for fixed samples; ensure all tubes passivated with BSA

steps.name: 10x Chromium GEM generation
steps.filter_before_loading: 40 um cell strainer to remove clumps
steps.critical_primer_addition: 1 uL of 2 uM U_fwd primer added to amplification mix alongside standard 10x cDNA primers (Step 90); without U_fwd, PLA products are not co-amplified

steps.name: SPRI size selection: separate cDNA from PLA products
steps.operation: mix x2 (two independent SPRI dispensations) + mix (cDNA elution)
steps.spri_ratio_cdna: 0.6x (cDNA ~1,000 bp binds beads; PLA ~100 bp stays in supernatant)
steps.critical_step_92: SAVE 75 uL supernatant for PLA library construction (CRITICAL: this supernatant is DISCARDED in standard 10x protocol)
steps.bioscript_ssa_note: Two independent dispense of SPRIselect_Beads (spriBeads_cDNA and spriBeads_PLA) used to avoid SSA single-use token violation; spriMix_cDNA consumed by elutedCDNA; spriMix_PLA flows through BB8/BB9 gate UNTOUCHED and consumed at bsbbif_10_j by plaCleanup

fail.troubleshooting: Check AMPure bead volume; avoid over-drying beads; peaks < 200 bp indicate adapter dimers

steps.name: cDNA gene expression library construction
steps.protocol_reference: 10x Genomics single-cell 3' V3.1; PCR cycles determined by cDNA input amount

steps.name: PLA product library construction
steps.operation: mix (2.1x SPRI cleanup) + mix (elute) + mix (PCR setup) + heat (12-cycle PCR) + mix (1.2x SPRI final cleanup) + mix (final elution) + detect (plaProductDetection)

pcr_program.note: 60 C anneal (lower than cDNA library) due to short PLA amplicon

fail.troubleshooting: Check AMPure bead volume for carryover; peaks < 200 bp indicate adapter dimers; repeat cleanup

cdna_library.read_distribution: Read 1: 28 cycles; i7 index: 10 cycles; i5 index: 10 cycles; Read 2: 90 cycles

pla_library.read_distribution: Read 1: 28 cycles; i7 index: 8 cycles; Read 2: 75 cycles
pla_library.phix_note: CRITICAL: 40% PhiX required due to low PLA library complexity; insufficient PhiX causes low Phred quality scores

steps.name: cDNA alignment (Cell Ranger)
steps.software: Cell Ranger v6.1.1 or higher (10x Genomics)
steps.output: Gene-barcode matrix (loadable in R with Read10x; Seurat/Scanpy compatible)

steps.name: PLA product alignment (custom Java program)
commands: ReadAlignment10x (extract cell barcode + UMI + probe identities from FASTQ)
UMIMerging (merge PLA products from same cell with similar UMI sequences)
DigitalCount (export DPE matrix as text file)

steps.name: Protein abundance calculation and protein complex quantification
steps: predictComplex (method='iterative' default; method='lr' for free oligo variant only) -> complex_count dataframe (Step 146-147)
steps.double_filtering: Filter invalid cell barcodes (mRNA-based correction) + filter cells with too few or too many PLA product UMIs
steps.proximity_noise_note: Proximity noise arises when two proteins are within 50-70 nm by random chance without functional interaction; the iterative method accounts for this computationally
steps.output: Integrated count matrices (mRNA + protein + protein complex) for multimodal single-cell analysis in Seurat or Scanpy

cfg.duration_units_note: BioScript supports s and m only; overnight 16h converted to 960m (IR: 57600.0 SECOND); on-ice 1h to 60m (IR: 3600.0 SECOND); sequencing run 10h to 600m (IR: 36000.0 SECOND)

ssa_liveness_fixes.root_cause: Compiler marks variable dead at join block if consumed in any preceding branch
ssa_liveness_fixes.fix: viableCells and stainedForSort derive independently from postLigWash2; viableCells is NOT consumed inside the if-gate branches (neither dispose nor drain); only stainedForSort is disposed/drained inside the gate

ssa_liveness_fixes.root_cause: Single SPRI mix variable consumed twice (cDNA elution + PLA cleanup) violated SSA single-use token semantics
ssa_liveness_fixes.fix: Two independent SPRIselect_Beads dispensations (spriBeads_cDNA and spriBeads_PLA) produce two separate mix variables; spriMix_PLA flows through the BB8/BB9 gate completely untouched and is consumed exactly once at bsbbif_10_j by plaCleanup

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Buffer exchange, DBCO stock prep, antibody conjugation, DBCO-Ab purification, detect dbcoConjugationQC; oligo conjugation overnight; probe panel assembly; cell pelleting, Fc block, probe staining, washes, PLA ligation, post-ligation washes; dead cell removal and PI staining independently from postLigWash2; detect viabilityDetection

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(dbcoSignal); oligo conjugation; probe panel assembly; cell staining; PLA ligation; post-ligation washes; viableCells (independent); stainedForSort (independent); detect viabilityDetection; split to viability gate

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(viabilitySignal); 10x GEM generation with viableCells1[0]; 12-cycle PCR with U_fwd; two independent SPRI dispensations; cDNA elution; detect proxseqLibraryQC; split to library QC gate

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_10_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(librarySignal); GEX library construction; PLA 2.1x SPRI cleanup using spriMix_PLA1[0]; PLA PCR; 1.2x SPRI final cleanup; detect plaProductDetection; split to final QC gate

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_11_t
basic_blocks.action: sequencing run: PhiX spike-in, NextSeq mid-output kit, seqRunMix; heat 600m at 4c; dispose(gexSeqPool); dispose(seqRunMix)

limitations.antibody_requirement: Antibodies must be selected carefully; probes must bind targets both individually and in complex; blocking/neutralizing antibodies must be avoided for receptor-ligand complex studies
limitations.interaction_range: 50-70 nm range cannot confirm direct protein-protein contact; other proteins may bridge the two targets; use FRET (5-10 nm range) for direct contact validation
limitations.multiplexing_upper_limit: Low hundreds of targets (estimated); determined by antibody availability and cost (~$1,000 per new probe pair, including oligos reusable across experiments)
limitations.lowly_abundant_proteins: Proteins not in complex with another panel target have little chance of forming a valid ligation product; difficult to identify lowly expressed surface proteins
limitations.computational_complexity: DPE matrix must be pre-filtered to discard all-zero rows/columns before protein complex quantification; zero denominator errors otherwise

PLA_RCA_DuoLink.limitation: No proximity noise correction; commercial kit (DuoLink)

proximity_sequencing.unique_advantage: Only single-cell method capable of measuring hundreds of protein complexes simultaneously; accounts for proximity noise computationally
